name: stock-price-tracker
description: A CLI tool for stock price tracking with watchlist management, strategy evaluation, and signal generation

scripts.scan: node dist/src/cli.js scan --tickers watchlist --strategy v3 --universe large_cap --allow-stale --summary
scripts.scan:notify: mkdir -p .stock-tracker/logs && node dist/src/cli.js scan --tickers watchlist --strategy v3 --universe large_cap --allow-stale --summary --log .stock-tracker/logs/scan_latest.json && node dist/src/discord-notify.js .stock-tracker/logs/scan_latest.json
scripts.scan:tech: node dist/src/cli.js scan --tickers watchlist --strategy v3 --universe tech --allow-stale --summary
scripts.scan:tech:notify: mkdir -p .stock-tracker/logs && node dist/src/cli.js scan --tickers watchlist --strategy v3 --universe tech --allow-stale --summary --log .stock-tracker/logs/scan_tech_latest.json && node dist/src/discord-notify.js .stock-tracker/logs/scan_tech_latest.json
scripts.scan:all: npm run scan && npm run scan:tech
scripts.scan-summary: node dist/src/cli.js scan --tickers watchlist --strategy v3 --universe large_cap --allow-stale --summary
